items.text: Rams listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip); missed practice, some groin soreness post-Thu, pre-game decision. Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip injury, missed Sat practice; unrelated to camp
items.implication: GTD; if out, TE heavy + Mumpfield/Fields bump
items.opportunity: Monitor active; backup WRs/TEs role expansion if inactive

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to out Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring; previously doubtful.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy to Bateman/Walker/others; Andrews bump
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL WRs/TEs

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: OUT/Doubtful Bowers, Collins, Flowers/Lane, Murray/Jennings, AJ Brown, Darnold, Penix/Tua etc. Q: McConkey, Olave, Burrow (playing), Pittman, Harvey, Black, McMillan. IN: Henderson, Pierce, Coker, Kamara, Tucker.
items.implication: Status changes drive beneficiaries and projections updates
items.opportunity: Snaps/targets for INs and backups of OUTs

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled out for Week 2 vs Bengals with hamstring injury sustained in Wednesday practice; not believed serious long-term but misses game.
items.implication: HOU WR crumbs; Schultz/Boutte/Hutchinson volume up

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs Texans; Rapoport notes good to go.
items.why: Listed Q but full practice/said playing; elevation precaution
items.implication: Burrow likely active; minimal change if plays
items.opportunity: CIN pass game full if active

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday; elevated Chris Myarick and Cody White from PS.
items.implication: LV TE volume to Myarick or WRs if out

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to out Sunday vs Patriots due to foot injury.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining PIT WRs

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. Practiced, listed Q.
items.why: Ribs; biggest Q impacting Herbert and LAC offense
items.implication: If limited/out, Johnston/others up; Herbert ceiling down
items.opportunity: Monitor status for LAC WR hierarchy and Herbert usage

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR. Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready; NE needs explosives, Brown IR, favorable stretch

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% target share Week 1; Indy gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start; massive season range

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 utilization Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches 3/4 last.
items.why: Elite util + consistent volume under Kubiak

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes W1, 69% points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
items.why: Reduced workload + Kamara return + poor script
items.conflict: If Kamara limited, Etienne retains more

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; Bears soft vs WRs.
DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% targets, 13.7 aDOT W1; TEN allowed high catch rate/YPR; soft vs WRs.
items.why: Strong aDOT/share + favorable matchup after tough W1
